name: malformed
description: One page carrying a healthy row, a null row, a bare-string row, and a row whose ip_address arrives as an ARRAY rather than the documented comma-separated string. A non-dict row used to abort the script inside page_signature or build_assets at the first .get, and an array ip_address aborted it at .split -- either way the whole task died on the first bad row. The malformed rows must be skipped with a log line, the array addressing must import both addresses, and the healthy row must import untouched. namespaced_ids is skipped: the id is the bare Endpoint Central resource_id with no server scope, the same pre-existing defect the happy scenario records.

scancomputers: this row is a string, not an object
